result.title: Computer-Use Agents Are Embodied Generalists
result.summary: In many areas of AI, general-purpose models have increasingly replaced handcrafted methods and specialized architectures. We argue that embodied AI is poised for a similar shift. Our key claim is that embodied tasks can be formulated as interaction with digital software. Specifically, we build software that renders an agent's view of a physical environment on a screen and provides controls for acting in it. A computer-use agent (CUA) can then perform embodied tasks through the same screenshots and keyboard and mouse actions that it uses to operate ordinary software. Using a single CUA design and changing only the software, our entries win first-, second-, third-, and sixth-place prizes across four ECCV workshop competitions, without any competition-specific agent tuning. These results suggest that the skills CUAs learn on software, such as visual grounding, precise clicking, and exploration, already carry over to embodied tasks, giving CUAs a far broader scope in embodied AI than previously realized. We therefore advocate that computer-use agents can be embodied generalists. Further, we advocate that, by following the training strategy that made computer-use agents general, embodied AI can converge on a single general model as well, ushering in a new era of general embodied AI. Website: https://pranjal2041.github.io/cua-embodied

AI.brief_summary: 论文主张把具身任务表述为与数字软件的交互，用一个 computer-use agent（截屏观察加键鼠操作）在四个 ECCV workshop 比赛中获得名次。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不涉及 latent 表示或推理状态生成，但把视觉 grounding、探索与动作决策统一到同一「观察—操作」循环，或可作为检验视觉证据获取与停止决策的工作场景，具体联系需核查。
